dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hello, Nam. This is Kevin from CityNet. I'm calling about your home visit on Friday.
dialogue.reading: həˈloʊ, ˈnɑːm. ðɪs ɪz ˈkɛvɪn frəm ˈsɪti ˌnɛt. aɪm ˈkɔːlɪŋ əˈbaʊt jʊr ˈhoʊm ˈvɪzɪt ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, hi, Kevin. Is everything OK?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈhaɪ, ˈkɛvɪn. ɪz ˈɛvriθɪŋ oʊˈkeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. Our technician will be arriving at around two. Will you be home then?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aʊr tɛkˈnɪʃən wɪl bi əˈraɪvɪŋ ət əˈraʊnd ˈtuː. wɪl juː bi ˈhoʊm ˈðɛn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Actually, I have an exam on Friday afternoon. Could I reschedule the visit?
dialogue.reading: ˈæktʃuəli, aɪ ˈhæv ən ɪɡˈzæm ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ ˌæftərˈnuːn. kʊd aɪ ˌriːˈskɛdʒuːl ðə ˈvɪzɪt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Of course. What's your preferred time?
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. ˈwʌts jʊr prɪˈfɜːrd ˈtaɪm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Saturday morning would be great. Will the technician be bringing a new router?
dialogue.reading: ˈsætərdeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ wʊd bi ˈɡreɪt. wɪl ðə tɛkˈnɪʃən bi ˈbrɪŋɪŋ ə ˈnuː ˈraʊtər?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, he will. Your new router will connect to the internet automatically.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, hiː ˈwɪl. jʊr ˈnuː ˈraʊtər wɪl kəˈnɛkt tə ði ˈɪntərnɛt ˌɔːtəˈmætɪkli.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great. What should I do in the meantime?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ˈwʌt ʃʊd aɪ ˈduː ɪn ðə ˈmiːntaɪm?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: In the meantime, we'll give you free internet on your phone. It'll be added to your account automatically.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ðə ˈmiːntaɪm, wiːl ˈɡɪv juː ˈfriː ˈɪntərnɛt ɑːn jʊr ˈfoʊn. ɪtəl bi ˈædɪd tə jʊr əˈkaʊnt ˌɔːtəˈmætɪkli.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Will you be needing anything else today?
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈwɛlkəm. wɪl juː bi ˈniːdɪŋ ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈɛls təˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, that's all. Thanks for your help.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ðæts ˈɔːl. ˈθæŋks fər jʊr ˈhɛlp.
